origin: Own extraction of formulas and criteria from the delivered PV course material (modules M1-M4); no text copied, values to be approved by a person.

performance_ratio.formula: PR = (1 - A - Ptemp) * B * C * D * E * F
performance_ratio.hps: equivalent peak-sun hours: daily irradiation on the module plane divided by 1 kW/m2

row_spacing.design_hour: solar noon, 21 June (southern hemisphere); +-2 h variant also tabulated

orientation_sensitivity.note: course example for one site; indicative only

economic.tlcc: total life-cycle cost: initial cost plus discounted O&M, fuel and replacement over the horizon
economic.rate_note: keep real and nominal rates consistent; discount rate drives LCOE strongly

loan_amortization.german: constant principal: P/n plus interest on the outstanding balance

economic.leverage_note: course case: TIR and VAN can rank projects differently (contradiction region below about 8.39 % discount); report both

operation_and_maintenance.monitoring: weather station (irradiance in plane, module temperature, ambient temperature, wind) plus inverter and string data

construction.note: course Gantt reference; durations are indicative

ley_26190_27191: fiscal certificate 20 % with at least 60 % national content, floor 30 %
regulatory.note: legal summary taken from course slides; must be checked against the current text by a person before use
